Additive Manufacturing (AM) emerges as a promising approach, particularly Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF), which allows for intricate designs, reduced material waste, and simplified assembly. However, certain issues still need to be addressed, including defects like cracks and porosities in the manufactured parts.
